# e2b_volume (Data Source)

Reads an E2B volume by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_volume" "example" {
  id = "volume_id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Volume ID.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Volume name.
